03 · Performance
Defy Report

Live campaign performance and agent activity in one dashboard, with AI commentary on what's working. Performance doesn't sit in a monthly deck — it updates live, feeds back into Monitor, and sharpens what Automate does next.

  • Campaign metrics — CPM, CPC, CTR and ROAS across every channel, live
  • Agent performance — emails sent, replies made, assets created, all tracked
  • AI commentary — plain-English analysis of what's driving results and what to do next
